title: What money is
examples: What is the difference between using coins and using a debit card?
Can you explain how a bank transfer actually works?
Why is money better than trading things directly?

explain.say: Long ago, people used a system called barter to trade things.
In barter, you trade one item directly for another item you need.
A problem with barter is finding someone who has what you want.

items: Need to find someone with apples
And who wants your pencils back

explain.say: Coins and notes are forms of money that make trading much easier.
Today, we also use digital money through apps and bank cards.

draw.text: Digital money via apps and cards

explain.say: For example, you can use a digital card to pay for a toy.

faq.a: Bartering is difficult because you must find someone who has what you want and who wants what you have. Money solves this problem by acting as a common way to exchange value.
asks: Why is money better than trading things?
What was wrong with just swapping items?

faq.q: How does digital money actually work?
faq.a: When you use digital money, the money moves electronically between banks, not physically. Your bank account is updated instantly when the payment goes through.
asks: How does my phone pay for things?

faq.q: Are coins and notes the same thing?
faq.a: Coins and notes are both physical forms of money accepted by law. Coins are metal, while notes are printed paper or polymer.
asks: What is the difference between a coin and a bill?
Can I use a plastic card instead?

faq.q: Do I need a bank account to use digital money?
faq.a: Usually, you need a bank account linked to a card to use most digital payment systems. This keeps track of your available funds.
asks: Can I pay without a bank?
What if I don't have a card?

faq.q: Is there a time when bartering was common?
faq.a: Bartering was used in many early human societies before standardized currency developed. It was common when trade was local and simple.
asks: Did all people barter before money?

facts: Barter involves exchanging goods or services directly.
Coins and notes are physical forms of currency.
Digital money uses electronic records in banks.
Money acts as a medium of exchange, making trade easier.

quiz.say: If you have extra books and need new shoes, what is the best way to trade?
quiz.show: Trade books for shoes using money.

options.show: Wait until you find a shoemaker who wants books.
options.say: Wait until you find a shoemaker who wants books.

options.show: Sell books for coins and then buy shoes.
options.say: Sell books for coins and then buy shoes.

options.show: Use money to buy what you need.
options.say: Use money to buy what you need.

quiz.why: Money is accepted by many people, so it is easier to find someone selling shoes.

wrong.0: This is bartering, and you might not find a shoemaker who wants your specific books.
wrong.1: This is too slow, and you might have to wait a very long time.
wrong.2: This is a good step, but using money directly is even faster.

quiz.say: If you pay for a snack using a payment app on your parent's phone, what kind of money is that?

options.show: A bank transfer on an app.
options.say: A bank transfer on an app.

quiz.why: The money moves electronically between accounts, which is digital money.

wrong.0: The money never left the electronic system, so it is not a physical coin.
wrong.1: While it uses a wallet, the actual movement is usually a bank transfer linked to it.
wrong.2: This describes credit, but the app payment is usually immediate when the transaction completes.

quiz.say: Which method allows you to buy apples from a baker and pencils from a student?
quiz.show: Best way to buy from two people.

options.show: Swap apples for coins, and pencils for coins.
options.say: Swap apples for coins, and pencils for coins.

options.show: Use money to buy both items.
options.say: Use money to buy both items.

options.show: Trade apples to the student for pencils.
options.say: Trade apples to the student for pencils.

options.show: Find a person who has apples and pencils and trade with them.
options.say: Find a person who has apples and pencils and trade with them.

quiz.why: Money is the most flexible tool because it can be used with many different sellers.

wrong.0: You cannot easily swap items for coins unless the seller accepts that method.
wrong.2: You would then have to use the pencils to buy apples from the baker, which is complicated.
wrong.3: This is very rare and unlikely to happen in a busy market.
